name: CASP Case-Control Study Checklist
license_note: Questions are consolidated paraphrases of the official checklist. The official wording is linked, not bundled.
notes: CASP questions are answered yes / can't tell / no and CASP defines no scoring or overall judgement, so none is derived. The domain list consolidates the official sections; consult the linked checklist for the full question set.

domains.name: Clearly focused issue
domains.short_prompt: Whether the study states its population, exposure, outcome, and results clearly enough to appraise.

domains.name: Case definition and selection
domains.short_prompt: Whether cases had inclusion/exclusion criteria, were representative of cases in the population, and were new or newly diagnosed where appropriate.

domains.name: Control selection
domains.short_prompt: Whether the controls represent the population from which the cases arose and were selected in a similar way to cases.

domains.name: Blind exposure measurement
domains.short_prompt: Whether exposure was measured without knowledge of case/control status, or recall bias was otherwise addressed.

domains.name: Confounders identified and controlled
domains.short_prompt: Whether all important confounders were identified and controlled through design or analysis.

domains.name: Matching handled in analysis
domains.short_prompt: If cases and controls were matched, whether matching was accounted for in the analysis.

domains.name: Precise results
domains.short_prompt: Whether the odds ratios are precise — confidence intervals and appropriate statistical tests.

domains.name: Dose-response pattern
domains.short_prompt: Whether the results show a dose-response pattern if the exposure is one that could plausibly have one.

domains.name: Conclusions justified
domains.short_prompt: Whether the conclusions follow from the results and acknowledge confounding, bias, imprecision, and generalisability.
